meta.title: Environmental politics knowledge network, c. 1968-2026
meta.description: Key works and debates in environmental and climate politics: the international climate regime, transnational and private governance, governance architecture and earth system governance, the political economy of climate policy, public opinion, denial and the countermovement, parties and populism, policy instruments, energy transitions, environmental and climate justice, adaptation, the commons, natural resources and the resource curse, climate and conflict, the environmental state and democracy, trade, finance and corporate power, and movements and litigation. Seeds come from this repo's papers.json; works shared with the other maps are imported from them; others are top-cited 2006-2026 articles selected via Crossref (nine environmental journals plus political science journals) and anchoring books and classics. Direction: source (later or dependent work) -> target (earlier or anchoring work).

edge_types.builds_on: source extends or relies on target's argument or evidence
edge_types.challenges: source contests target's claim, mechanism or evidence
edge_types.qualifies: source adds a scope condition or moderating factor to target
edge_types.extends_to_new_case: source applies target's logic to a new population, period or domain
edge_types.synthesizes: source integrates target with other work
edge_types.mechanism_tested_by: source tests a mechanism implied by target

meta.verification: Repo works come from the user's Zotero library. Works imported from the other maps keep their verification. Crossref-selected works take title, authors, year, venue and DOI from Crossref records. Anchors are checked in Crossref separately; see each node's `verified` field. One-line claims for non-repo works are my summaries.
